component.name: Křižík
component.summary: Monitor USB testers and multimeters over Bluetooth and USB

description.p: Křižík connects to USB testers and OWON multimeters over Bluetooth LE or a USB cable, on GNOME desktops and Linux phones. A tester and a multimeter can be used at the same time, for example to log a battery's temperature while it charges.

ul.li: Live voltage, current, power, D+/D−, CC1/CC2, load resistance and temperature
Detected fast-charging protocol and requested gear
Real-time graph with selectable series and time span
Capacity (mAh) and energy (Wh) counting with min/avg/max statistics
Alarms and automatic stop, for example when charging has finished
Multimeter readings with function, range and HOLD/REL/MIN/MAX state, on the same graph
Remote control of the multimeter's buttons and download of its offline recordings
USB testers over a cable: ALIENTEK C0, C2 and UT70, FNIRSI FNB58, FNB-C2, FNB48S, FNB48 and C1
Renaming the tester's and the multimeter's Bluetooth name

description.p: Named after František Křižík (1847–1941), the Czech electrical engineer and inventor.
Křižík is an independent project and is not affiliated with ALIENTEK, OWON or FNIRSI.

screenshot.caption: Graph of a tester and a multimeter on a shared time line
